Frequently Asked Questions

Common questions about contacting us

How can I contact World Time Clock support?

You can reach us directly by email at contact@timeinworldclock.com. We aim to respond to all inquiries within 24-48 hours.

What types of inquiries do you handle?

We handle all types of inquiries including questions about time zones, feature requests, bug reports, partnership opportunities, and general feedback about our tools.

Do you offer technical support for your time tools?

Yes! If you're having trouble using any of our features or have questions about how time zone calculations work, just email us and we'll be happy to assist.

Can I suggest new features for the website?

Absolutely! We welcome feature suggestions from our users. Email us with your ideas and we'll consider them for future updates.

Is there a phone number I can call?

We currently offer email support only. This allows us to provide thoughtful, detailed responses to all inquiries and maintain our free service.

How quickly will I get a response?

Most emails receive a response within 24-48 hours. During weekends and holidays, response times may be slightly longer.
